title: [PowerRename] Previous settings do not get restored after using "Time used for replacement" = "Modification Time"

judgment.rationale: Separate serialized flag preservation from the independent text history. Reproduce the reported time-source transition and compare flags before write and after read; a bitmask/persistence defect is a hypothesis, not a confirmed root cause.
evidence: The author supplies before/after screenshots and a control where leaving the time option unchanged restores settings correctly.
The problem affects regex, target scope, subfolders and time-source settings, while search/replace text survives.
Bug-report generation itself fails; that is not a reason to require another generic archive.

Upstream main 9e6593c34949: src/modules/powerrename/PowerRenameUILib/PowerRenameXAML/MainWindow.xaml.cpp: ReadSettings reads CSettingsInstance.GetFlags and separate LastRunSettings text; WriteSettings writes manager flags separately from text.

fix_assessment.rationale: Conditional lightweight proposal, not an implementation-grade design. The differential report and separate source persistence paths support the boundary, but no failing flag value has been captured.
